description: Real FlightRadar24-style live map view of local Mumbai FIR airspace. Dark terrain map with aircraft icons moving in real-time. Mock data only. Uses Leaflet.js with a dark tile layer. Shows only the Mumbai TMA/FIR sector — NOT the whole country.

library.name: Leaflet.js
library.why: Leaflet is lightweight, works with React via useEffect, and supports custom SVG/Canvas aircraft icons on top of map tiles

map_config.note: Centered on VABB — Mumbai CSIA airport
map_config.zoom_note: Zoom 8 shows roughly 400km radius — covers Mumbai TMA + surrounding sector airspace

tile_layer.why: Dark terrain tiles that match the NERV/military ops aesthetic perfectly. No API key needed.

map_config.bounds_note: Soft-lock map bounds to roughly Gujarat/Maharashtra/Goa/MP region so user cannot pan to unrelated areas

sector_boundary.description: Dashed polygon showing the Mumbai FIR boundary
sector_boundary.label: MUMBAI FIR — VABB

tma_zone.description: Inner circle showing Mumbai TMA (Terminal Maneuvering Area) — ~80km radius around airport
tma_zone.style: color: #00e5cc, weight: 1, opacity: 0.35, dashArray: '4 4', fillOpacity: 0.03, fillColor: #00e5cc

approach_corridors.description: Thin amber lines showing ILS approach paths for active runways

waypoints.description: Named navigation fixes shown as small teal diamonds with labels
waypoints.style: teal diamond SVG icon, 8px, label in Share Tech Mono 9px

airport_marker.description: VABB airport shown as a bold amber cross/runway icon at center
airport_marker.style: Custom SVG — two crossed rectangles representing runways, amber color, 24px
airport_marker.label: VABB — CSIA

aircraft_icons.shape: Airplane silhouette SVG — top-down view of aircraft. Rotated to match heading.
aircraft_icons.size: 28x28px default. Conflict aircraft: 32x32px with pulsing ring.
aircraft_icons.rotation: icon rotates to match flight heading in degrees

label_popup.show_on: always visible for conflict flights, hover for others
label_popup.style: dark bg #0a0b0e, amber border 1px, Share Tech Mono 10px, no border-radius, padding 4px 8px

conflict_effect.description: Pulsing red circle ring animates around conflict aircraft icons
conflict_effect.implementation: CSS animation on a circle element behind the icon, scale 1→1.8, opacity 1→0, 1s loop

flight_positions.note: All positions are mock. Aircraft move via setInterval every 2 seconds, advancing along heading vector. Speed determines distance moved per tick.
flight_positions.movement_formula: new_lat = lat + (speed_kts * 0.000290) * cos(heading_rad) * 2s_factor; new_lng = lng + (speed_kts * 0.000290) * sin(heading_rad) * 2s_factor

map_controls.position: Absolute positioned over map, top-left corner

elements.name: Filter buttons
elements.style: Pill buttons, dark bg, amber border on active, 11px monospace. Clicking filters which aircraft icons show on map.

elements.name: Altitude layer selector
elements.style: Same pill style. Filters aircraft by altitude band and dims others.

elements.name: Sector info overlay
elements.content: MODE: APP/DEP | RANGE: TMA 80NM | SECTOR: 7B-ALPHA | FILTER: ALL
elements.style: Top-left corner, dark semi-transparent bg, Share Tech Mono 10px amber/50, no border

split_view_toggle.description: A toggle button in the map panel header lets the controller switch between two center panel views
split_view_toggle.behavior: Clicking toggle switches the center panel between FlightRadarMap and the classic RadarCanvas sweep. Both components stay mounted (display:none swap) so radar sweep animation doesn't reset.
split_view_toggle.button_style: Two pills side by side. Active = amber bg black text. Inactive = transparent amber border.

react_implementation.imports: import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Polyline, Circle, Tooltip, useMap } from 'react-leaflet'
react_implementation.custom_icon: Use L.divIcon with dangerouslySetInnerHTML SVG airplane shape, className for CSS animation
react_implementation.update_positions: useEffect with setInterval 2000ms — updates flightPositions state array. Leaflet markers re-render automatically.
react_implementation.custom_icon_code:
const makeIcon = (flight) => L.divIcon({ className: '', html: `
${flight.status==='conflict'?'
':''}
`, iconSize: [28,28], iconAnchor: [14,14] })
react_implementation.hide_default_tiles_text: Use CartoDB dark_all — no ugly text watermark

css_additions.aircraft_icon_base: .aircraft-icon { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; }
css_additions.conflict_pulse: @keyframes conflict-pulse { 0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; } 100% { transform: scale(2.2); opacity: 0; } } .pulse-ring { position: absolute; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #ff2d2d; animation: conflict-pulse 1s ease-out infinite; }
css_additions.tooltip_style: .aircraft-tooltip { background: #0a0b0e; border: 1px solid #f5a623; color: #f5a623; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono'; font-size: 10px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 0; white-space: nowrap; }

what_NOT_to_do: Do NOT use Google Maps — requires API key and billing
Do NOT use Mapbox — requires API key
Do NOT show the whole India map — zoom to Mumbai TMA only
Do NOT use real FlightRadar24 data — all mock data from the flights array above
Do NOT remove the circular RadarCanvas — keep both and let toggle switch between them
Do NOT show airport pins like FlightRadar24 — only show VABB and named waypoints
cursor_instruction: Add FlightRadarMap.jsx as a new component. In App.jsx add a mapView state (default 'map'). In the center column, render a toggle button row with MAP VIEW and RADAR SWEEP pills. Below the toggle, conditionally render FlightRadarMap or RadarCanvas based on mapView state. FlightRadarMap gets the same flights prop as RadarCanvas. Wire the aircraft onClick on the map to the same setSelectedFlight handler so clicking a plane on the map highlights it in the flight list and opens the detail drawer.
